npc.beyondsolo.association.broker.unregi: No license, no business. Get yourself evaluated, then we'll talk.

association.beyondsolo.standing.elite.pe: Bounties pay 20% more, and brokers sell to you for 20% less.
association.beyondsolo.standing.national: Bounties pay 30% more, and the title Pride of the Association.

quest.beyondsolo.association.outcome.clo: The gate closed, or broke loose, before you cleared it.
quest_objective.beyondsolo.association.a: Alone: no party, no hired hands

ui.beyondsolo.association.title: Hunter Association
ui.beyondsolo.association.contracts.empt: No open gates within %s blocks of this office right now. Gates open all the time: come back later, or ask the broker what they know.
ui.beyondsolo.association.hint.take: Take the contract: close this %s-rank gate for the bounty
ui.beyondsolo.association.hint.drop: Give the contract back to the office (it counts as failed)
ui.beyondsolo.association.hint.full: You hold as many contracts as your standing allows
ui.beyondsolo.association.permits.title: GATE PERMITS
ui.beyondsolo.association.permits.desc: Ask for a gate of the rank you want. The association opens one nearby and holds its clearing rights for you: only you and your party may enter it.
ui.beyondsolo.association.hint.permit: A permit for a rank %s gate, %s gold
ui.beyondsolo.association.hint.permit_ra: Your license allows permits up to %s-rank gates
ui.beyondsolo.association.exam.title: RANK EXAM
ui.beyondsolo.association.exam.top: There is no rank above yours. The association has nothing left to test.
ui.beyondsolo.association.exam.desc: Clear a rank %s gate the association opens for you, alone and in time, and your license is reissued at that rank.
ui.beyondsolo.association.exam.ready: Your strength has outgrown your license. You may sit the exam.
ui.beyondsolo.association.exam.block.top: There is no rank above yours.
ui.beyondsolo.association.exam.block.ret: You failed your last exam. You may sit it again in %s day(s).
ui.beyondsolo.association.exam.block.no_: The crystal reads you at the rank you hold. The exam is only offered once your strength has outgrown your license.
ui.beyondsolo.association.broker.title: Gate Broker
ui.beyondsolo.association.broker.quote.0: The association posts what it wants you to know. I sell the rest.
ui.beyondsolo.association.broker.quote.1: Every gate has a story before anyone walks in. I just get there first.
ui.beyondsolo.association.broker.quote.2: Coin first, questions never. Which rank are we talking about?
ui.beyondsolo.association.broker.quote.3: A hunter who walks in blind walks out in pieces. Or doesn't.
ui.beyondsolo.association.broker.quote.4: I hear the air tear before the officers do. Interested?
ui.beyondsolo.association.broker.whereab: Name a rank. If I know of a gate like that you haven't heard of, I'll tell you where it is. If I don't, I know where one is about to open.
A lead goes in your quest log with a waypoint, and it's done once you reach the gate. What you do with it is your business.
ui.beyondsolo.association.broker.hint.no: That's all I'm selling today. Come back tomorrow.
ui.beyondsolo.association.broker.hint.ti: The whereabouts of a rank %s gate you haven't heard of, %s gold
Word of a rank %s gate about to open, %s gold
ui.beyondsolo.association.broker.scoutin: gates you know of within %s blocks
You know of no open gates within %s blocks of here. Buy a lead first, or go and look.
My people can tell you what waits behind this %s-rank gate: its dungeon and layout, its boss, its element and weather, whether a hidden chamber is rumoured, how deep it runs and how long it holds.
This gate is above your rank.
ui.beyondsolo.association.broker.hint.sc: A report on the %s-rank gate, %s gold
